selective_antecedent_rule: Before 1990, backfill only material antecedents needed to explain an institution, policy regime, balance-sheet structure, product, crisis, actor or vocabulary inside the primary horizon.

recursive_questions_for_high_importance_: Who else or which institution was connected?
What preceded this and what balance-sheet or policy condition made it possible?
What followed, and through which bank type or business line did it transmit?
What was it called then, including old institution names, policy phrases, products and accounting terms?
What failed, was merged, recapitalized, hidden off balance sheet or later reclassified?
What would a veteran China-bank analyst say is missing from this story?
evidence_transition_policy: No new Banking evidence search for an unsealed shard. Once a shard is genuinely sealed, post-seal self-verification may begin claim by claim while other unsealed shards continue blind recall in isolated contexts.

preexposure_carveout.subject: China Merchants Bank 2023-08-28 interim-results management discussion
preexposure_carveout.rule: Do not count directly overlapping recollection as clean blind evidence of model memory; retain it only as provenance/context and re-run equivalent industry questions through other institutions/time slices where possible.
